command: set -euo pipefail; ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 andreas@100.92.234.52 'set -e; echo JOURNAL_BEGIN; journalctl --user -u frankenstein-local-bridge.service -n 80 --no-pager | tail -80; echo JOURNAL_END; S=$HOME/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo; echo STATE_REPO=$S; if [ -d "$S/.git" ]; then git -C "$S" status --short --branch; echo HEAD=$(git -C "$S" rev-parse HEAD); echo REMOTES_BEGIN; git -C "$S" remote -v | sed -E "s#(https://)[^/@]+@#\1REDACTED@#g"; echo REMOTES_END; echo BRANCHES_BEGIN; git -C "$S" branch -avv | tail -20; echo BRANCHES_END; fi; DB=$HOME/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/executed.sqlite; if [ -f "$DB" ]; then echo EXEC_DB=$DB; sqlite3 "$DB" ".tables"; sqlite3 "$DB" "select * from sqlite_master where type=\x27table\x27;" | head -5; fi'
